lines: Made-up data room for testing agents. Every company, person and figure here is fictional.

Revenue per customer is the total across all group companies, contracts and project work, on the management accounts basis. The ten largest customers by H1 FY2027 revenue are listed. Customers that no longer trade with the group are not listed. Every other customer still trading with the group had less than 2.0% of group revenue in each period shown.
FY2026: year ended 31 March 2026. H1 FY2027: six months ended 30 September 2026. Figures before audit adjustments; see 2.6.
